name: charm_quark
tier: Tier 3 (Mixed-Harmonic ansatz, N=17 second-harmonic) + Tier 4 as evidence that phi explains the value (constant control test v3 NEGATIVE-FRAGILE; App PSC §PSC.9.6)

extra.engine_branch_note: Engine uses FK²_charm in place of φ^(13+φ^-3). Both branches happen to give ~1263 MeV due to FK calibration. Manuscript branch value is reproducible from the prose formula.
